items.title: Ferrand Clementin Interview, 1973-08-02
items.q: They didn't shoot the balloon, Mom. They didn't shoot the balloon.

ctx.x: And you had a roof made for the same distance and then you cut the roof. What the purpose was to set a balloon up? She'd go up in the balloon parachute. She wanted to go first. But they used to shoot the balloon. They used to do that. They would loose the head slowly. That's how they used to do it. The cousins said the balloon goes so far. When the wood got a certain distance high enough, they would shoot that balloon. When they shoot well, they would see that balloon and they would loose the head.
They didn't shoot the balloon, Mom. They didn't shoot the balloon.
That's the way they had it. They told me they did that. Oh, but they told you wrong. They told you wrong. How did it come down? Huh? How why did it come down?
